chapters.title: Create an account
chapters.instruction: Choose Google or email. For email, verify the inbox link to continue. Set your optional preferences or skip them.
chapters.alt: Email signup form with Google sign-in and empty account fields.

chapters.title: Start a project
chapters.instruction: Choose Start from an app to review a reference plan, or Start from an idea to describe your own project. In Websites and the public Builder, both choices are under New project.
chapters.alt: Application workspace with a New application control and a synthetic demo project.

chapters.title: Build with AI
chapters.instruction: Describe the result, then choose Build page for a website or Build for an app. Wait for a complete preview and check its source label.
chapters.alt: Completed NOVA demo website in Builder, labeled Saved preview.

chapters.title: Refine in chat
chapters.instruction: Describe one change. In Websites, choose Update page; in Applications, choose Update. Let the update finish before the next change.
chapters.alt: Website refinement composer and real revisions for the fictional NOVA project.

chapters.title: Adjust the design
chapters.instruction: Open Design. A website control starts a refinement. In applications, choose your theme, accent, type and spacing, then Apply design.
chapters.alt: Open Design controls beside the actual NOVA website preview.

chapters.title: Preview each screen
chapters.instruction: Use Desktop, Tablet or Mobile to inspect the project. Try app forms with synthetic records, and choose Save to keep a record.
chapters.alt: Actual mobile-width website preview inside Builder.

chapters.title: Restore a version
chapters.instruction: Once you have revisions, open History, inspect one, then Restore. In apps, this restores the design and structure; data records stay intact.
chapters.alt: History with real saved website revisions and restore controls.

chapters.title: Save and reopen
chapters.instruction: Save on this device keeps a local website. In your signed-in workspace, use Save to account and Saved websites. Data apps save to your account.
chapters.alt: Saved websites panel showing the synthetic NOVA project saved to the account.

chapters.title: Check connections
chapters.instruction: In your signed-in workspace, open Integrations for availability and permissions. These tools are not connected here; Google sign-in is separate.
chapters.alt: Real Connections panel showing that work-tool integrations are unavailable until configured.

chapters.title: Export or share
chapters.instruction: Export downloads website HTML or an app ZIP/data. In your workspace, Publishing can share a saved website where enabled; it is not full app hosting.
chapters.alt: Actual website Export menu with HTML download controls.

chapters.title: Check usage
chapters.instruction: In your signed-in workspace, open More → Usage for measured build activity. Payments and credit purchases are off; no active checkout is offered.
chapters.alt: Actual Usage panel showing measured build activity: an accepted request with input/output token counts and failed attempts marked Token counts unavailable.
